jobs.title: EHR Integration Data Architect
jobs.description:
**EHR Integration Data Architect**
==================================

Dynamic Integrated Services (DIS) is a proud Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business based in the Washington, D.C. Metropolitan area providing management consulting services to the Federal Government and organizations supporting federal agencies. With many years of public sector expertise, DIS offers client services and support in the areas of Strategic Communications and Integrated Marketing (SCIM), Information Technology (IT), and Enterprise Optimization (EO).

DIS is seeking an experienced **EHR Integration Data Architect** to support a large-scale Electronic Health Record (EHR) Modernization program. This position will serve as the data-focused architecture lead supporting healthcare interoperability, integration strategy, clinical data exchange, and site activation initiatives. The successful candidate will provide both strategic guidance and hands-on support within a collaborative architecture and engineering organization, partnering with clinical, technical, and functional stakeholders to drive successful healthcare system integrations across multiple deployment markets.

At DIS, we are team oriented, continuous learners, hard-working, creative thinkers, and most of all kind people. We're a different kind of company with a truly unique culture, one that values our employees and shares a passion for serving our clients. If you enjoy solving complex interoperability challenges, designing scalable healthcare integration architectures, and supporting mission-critical healthcare modernization efforts, we'd like to meet you.

**Essential Duties**
--------------------

The **EHR Integration Data Architect** will support enterprise healthcare interoperability and integration architecture activities across a complex EHR modernization environment. In addition, the EHR Integration Data Architect will perform the following specific activities:

* Lead healthcare interoperability architecture efforts supporting enterprise EHR deployments and modernization initiatives.
* Develop and maintain integration strategies that support the exchange of clinical and operational healthcare data across multiple systems and vendors.
* Provide architecture guidance and technical leadership to integration engineering teams and project stakeholders.
* Support the design and implementation of interoperability solutions utilizing HL7, FHIR, CCD, DICOM, and related healthcare messaging standards.
* Lead analysis and design activities supporting API management, interface engines, and system-to-system data exchange.
* Define integration patterns supporting push, pull, hybrid, and event-driven architectures.
* Analyze healthcare information exchange requirements involving demographics, orders, results, pharmacy, laboratory, imaging, scheduling, and ancillary systems.
* Develop integration blueprints, architecture roadmaps, interface control documents (ICDs), and data flow diagrams.
* Support the identification and management of authoritative sources of data across the enterprise ecosystem.
* Facilitate architecture reviews, technical briefings, engineering analyses, and courses of action (COA) development.
* Coordinate with government stakeholders, vendors, architects, engineers, clinicians, and operational teams to ensure integration requirements are met.
* Support market activation planning, cutover readiness activities, mock conversions, dress rehearsals, and Go-Live support.
* Troubleshoot integration issues and facilitate root cause analysis and remediation activities.
* Support cloud migration initiatives, including the transition of interfaces, clinical data flows, and workloads to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments.
* Ensure interoperability solutions comply with organizational security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
* Develop enterprise-level reporting, metrics, and dashboards supporting integration visibility, capacity planning, and decision-making.
* Assess and recommend opportunities for process improvement, integration standardization, and operational efficiencies.

**Required Experience and Qualifications**
------------------------------------------

* Experience supporting Electronic Health Record (EHR) implementations, healthcare interoperability programs, or healthcare modernization initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience with healthcare interoperability standards including HL7, FHIR, CCD, and DICOM.
* Knowledge of healthcare clinical vocabularies and terminologies including ICD-10, LOINC, SNOMED-CT, and related standards.
* Experience designing and supporting APIs, interface engines, and healthcare integration solutions.
* Understanding of healthcare data exchange patterns, interface architectures, and enterprise integration methodologies.
* Familiarity with clinical workflows including pharmacy, laboratory, radiology/imaging, scheduling, and ancillary healthcare systems.
* Experience developing architecture artifacts including integration blueprints, interface specifications, data flow diagrams, and technical documentation.
* Knowledge of healthcare privacy and security requirements including HIPAA, PII, and PHI protections.
* Understanding of encryption, identity management, authentication, and authorization frameworks including OAuth 2.0 and SMART on FHIR.
* Experience supporting data migration, conversion planning, and healthcare implementation readiness activities.
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across technical, operational, clinical, and executive stakeholder groups.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 applications.
* Ability to work independently and thrive within a fast-paced, high-visibility environment.
* Applicants must have the legal right to work in the U.S. for any employer as sponsorship is not available for this position.
* Preference will be given to qualified Veteran candidates.

**Preferred Experience & Qualifications**
-----------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Health Informatics, Healthcare Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* Additional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Experience with Oracle Health (Cerner), Epic, or other enterprise healthcare platforms.
* Experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Department of Defense (DoD), or other federal healthcare modernization initiatives.
* Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), cloud migration, or hybrid-cloud healthcare environments.
* Experience supporting large-scale healthcare system integrations across multiple geographic markets.
* Familiarity with Interface Engines such as Oracle Health Ignite, Cloverleaf, Rhapsody, Mirth Connect, or Corepoint.
* Experience developing executive-level reporting, analytics, and operational dashboards.
* Knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks and governance processes.
* PMP, TOGAF, HL7, FHIR, or related industry certifications preferred.

**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------

The physical demands described below are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

* Frequently required to sit and work at a desk/computer for extended periods of time.
* While performing the responsibilities of the job, the employee is required to talk and hear.
* Must be able to have repetitive wrist, hand, and finger movement while operating a computer and other office equipment.
* Vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to view computer screens for prolonged periods.

Salary is commensurate with experience.

\*Dynamic Integrated Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, national origin, age, gender/sex, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, military/veteran status, citizenship status, the basis of genetic information or any other group protected by Federal or State law or local ordinance. People with disabilities who need a reasonable accommodation to apply or compete for employment may request such accommodation(s).\*

jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

We're not just another SaaS company. We're chiropractors and software veterans who got tired of watching practices struggle with clunky, outdated systems. So we built something better.

ChiroHD (https://www.chirohd.com/) is the cloud-based practice management platform that actually gets chiropractic. Scheduling, EHR, billing, patient communication - everything a modern practice needs, built specifically for how chiropractors actually work. No more trying to force-fit horizontal software into your vertical world. We've cracked the code on product-market fit - prepped, proven, and ready for scale!

**Role Overview:**

As an Onboarding Specialist, you're the first person our new customers work with after they sign, and you set the tone for their entire experience with us. You'll lead live kickoff and training calls, provide guidance and support as customers work through their own account setup, and help ensure they feel confident and prepared to use the product by the time they go live.

Our onboarding process is primarily self-guided, meaning customers are responsible for completing their own setup, while you serve as a trusted resource to answer questions, provide direction, and help them navigate the process successfully.

This is a customer-focused, hands-on role on a growing onboarding team. Your work directly impacts how quickly customers become successful with our product and their long-term satisfaction and retention.

**What You'll Do**

* **Lead Live Training.** Run kickoff and training calls that introduce new customers to the onboarding process, explain setup expectations, and demonstrate how to use the product in their day-to-day operations.
* **Support Customers Through Go-Live.** Serve as a resource throughout the customer-led onboarding process, providing guidance, answering questions, setting clear expectations, and helping customers stay on track toward a successful launch.
* **Assist with Launch Readiness.** Provide guidance on account configuration and complete light configuration tasks when needed to support a successful go-live, while ensuring customers remain responsible for their own account setup.
* **Follow Up Proactively.** Reach out to customers who are stalled or struggling, offer assistance when needed, and flag early signs of risk to your manager.
* **Improve the Process.** Keep onboarding records accurate and current, and share customer feedback and recurring friction points with the team so we can continuously improve the onboarding experience.

**Who You Are:**

* **Experienced**. You have 1–3 years of experience in SaaS onboarding, implementation, or a similar customer-facing role.
* **Effective Communicator**. You're a confident, friendly communicator who can lead a live training call and make a non-technical person feel capable.
* **Customer-Focused**. You care about customers' outcomes, not just finishing the checklist. You want them to be using the product and getting value from it.
* **Organized and Dependable**. You can manage a full caseload of clinics at different stages without losing track of next steps or commitments.
* **Quick Learner**. You pick up new software quickly and can explain it simply, even when you're still learning it.
* **Self-Directed**. You're comfortable working remotely, taking feedback, and sharing what you learn with the team.

**Preferred Experience (Nice-to-Have):**

* Hands-on experience in a medical practice or with EHR software (ChiroHD preferred)
* Experience using Customer Success tools like Gainsight or ChurnZero
* History of supporting small business customers directly
* Proven ability to document, refine, and improve workflows
* Skillful at using AI tools to boost efficiency and productivity

**Non-Negotiables (Disqualifiers):**

* Lacks prior experience in SaaS onboarding or software implementation
* Lacks customer-facing experience conducting live training or kickoff calls
* Unable to work standard working hours in Central or Eastern Time

**Why ChiroHD?**

**Impact & Growth:**

* Vertical SaaS category leader in a wide market.
* PE-backed with $26M in growth capital to scale aggressively.
* Established product-market fit; scaling outbound-led growth engine now.
* High-caliber sales culture focused on coaching, commercial excellence, and real career growth.
* Direct leadership access, no bureaucracy, high visibility.

**Culture & Values:**

* Customer-obsessed team that puts patient care at the center of everything we do
* Low-ego, builder-first environment where the best ideas win
* High-accountability culture with emphasis on ownership and results
* Commitment to work-life balance and professional development

**Compensation & Benefits:**

* Competitive salary
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
* Flexible PTO and remote-first culture

jobs.title: Market Associate - Hotel Onboarding
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

We're hiring a Market Associate to support the hotel partnerships team at a global travel marketplace. You'll manage a high volume of hotel partners and take each one from signed agreement to live and bookable on the platform. This is an operations and onboarding role, not a sales role. You'll take handoffs from several Account Executives, keep a busy pipeline moving through each stage, and hand launched properties to Market Managers. The role suits someone organized and detail-oriented who does well with repeatable, process-driven work.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Manage a pipeline of hotel partners and move each one from handover to live and bookable on the platform.
* Triage internal hotel queues and support connectivity setup. Work with hotels and their connectivity partners to resolve issues and confirm that rates, inventory and availability flow correctly.
* Review listing details (room types, photos, rates, availability) to confirm each property is guest-ready, then set it live.
* Guide hotels through required identity and business verification (KYC), then hand properties off to Market Managers.
* Take work in from several Account Executives and coordinate handoffs to several Market Managers.
* Contact hotel partners by phone, email and Zoom to collect business details and move assigned projects forward.
* Keep detailed, well-organized tracking for every property and project.
* Track progress against weekly and quarterly go-live targets, and prioritize the properties closest to launch.
* Teach partners how the platform works, and build strong, lasting partner relationships.
* Act as a responsive "front desk" for hotel partners: triage their requests and give timely, high-quality service.
* Find ways to manage and streamline workflows.

### **Qualifications**

**Required**

* 3+ years of experience in account management, partner support or partner onboarding.
* Very strong attention to detail.
* Strong organizational skills, including keeping a large pipeline of work moving across several stages.
* Comfortable with repeatable, process-driven work at high volume.
* Strong time management and prioritization, and the ability to adapt as priorities and deadlines change.
* Excellent communication skills across phone, email and Zoom.
* Strong people skills, including working with several internal teams whose roles overlap.
* A self-starter who gets things done, uses initiative and works independently with little hand-holding.
* Driven by goals, and comfortable with a high volume of calls and meetings.

**Preferred**

* 2+ years of experience in the hospitality or travel industry.
* Experience onboarding partners onto an online marketplace or platform. Examples include online travel agencies, property management systems, booking engines, and channel or connectivity providers. Onboarding experience from other marketplaces, such as car rental or mobility platforms, also transfers well.
* Experience working with hotel connectivity (rates, inventory, availability).
* Based in the Mid-Atlantic or Northeast.

### **Key Details**

* **Start date:** December 8, 2026
* **Duration:** About 12 months (through December 3, 2027), with possible extension
* **Location:** Remote, home-office based. Candidates must live in the U.S. east of the Mississippi River. No travel required.
* **Work schedule:** Full-time, 40 hours/week, 5 days/week
* **Pay rate range:** $45.00-$53.00/hour + benefits
* Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.
* Engagement: W-2 Contract

jobs.title: Scaled Operations & Escalations Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

This role is the primary driver for ensuring our **Scaled** customer segment achieves a seamless, high-value experience on Rippling. You are the strategic lead for navigating complex account milestones and specialized technical scenarios. As a Success Operator, you act as a cross-functional project manager to resolve friction points and ensure every account is positioned for a frictionless renewal.

**We are not hiring in the San Francisco Bay Area or New York City Metro.**  
  
**How you’ll spend your time:**

* **80% Targeted Solutioning & Resolution:** You will lead the charge on high-priority cases, acting as a project manager to align internal teams and deliver rapid, comprehensive solutions. You’ll navigate complex scenarios to ensure the customer’s partnership with Rippling remains strong.
* **20% Proactive Health & Optimization:** You will use data-driven insights to identify accounts that need additional guidance before they face hurdles. By identifying these trends, you’ll help refine our internal processes to improve the experience for all Scaled clients.

You’ll monitor key health indicators, such as support ticket patterns and product engagement. When you identify an opportunity to optimize an account, you’ll reach out to the customer to resolve potential frustrations and improve their account health long before it reaches a critical point.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Account Health & Specialized Resolution (80% of Role)**
* **Lead End-to-End Success Workstreams:** Serve as the primary project lead for sensitive account milestones. You will drive the resolution of complex, cross-departmental challenges from discovery to completion.
* **Orchestrate Internal Excellence:** Act as the central hub between Support, AM, and Product teams. You demonstrate total ownership in high-stakes situations where swift coordination is essential to a healthy partnership.
* **Direct-to-Customer Success Liaison:** Act as the polished, authoritative point of contact for Scaled clients navigating complex billing or product configurations. You build trust by serving as the customer’s dedicated champion and technical navigator inside Rippling.
* **Strategic Communication:** Translate technical or financial complexities into clear, actionable narratives for both the client and internal leadership.

### **Proactive Enablement & Insights (20% of Role)**

* **Anticipate & Optimize Trends:** Conduct strategic account audits to identify early indicators of friction. You will monitor health signals to intervene and improve the customer journey proactively.

**Empower & Enable for Long-Term Success:** Bridge the gap between "technical resolution" and "platform mastery." You will lead targeted sessions to ensure customers are technically confident and fully utilizing the Rippling ecosystem.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* **Experience:** 3+ years in a high-intensity, customer-facing role such as Customer Support, Escalations, or Technical Account Management.
* **The Solution Finder Mindset:** You have a passion for deconstructing complex problems and seeing a resolution through to the very end, you thrive on finding the "path to yes.
* **Project Management Prowess:** Proven ability to act as a project manager, coordinating dozens of moving pieces across multiple departments (Legal, Finance, Product) simultaneously without losing momentum.
* **Collaborative Communicator:** Exceptional ability to drive strong, transparent communications. You know how to keep Account Managers and stakeholders "in the loop" while managing the heavy lifting of a resolution.
* **De-escalation Expertise:** Exceptional ability to navigate sensitive client conversations with poise, maintaining a firm commercial stance while ensuring the customer feels heard and supported.
* **Technical Savvy:** Comfortable navigating complex billing systems and CRM (SFDC) reporting to identify data-driven solutions and trends.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Description:

**ABOUT METRC**

Metrc is the most trusted and experienced provider of cannabis regulatory systems in the United States and is growing extremely rapidly to expand globally. We provide a solution that combines advanced software, radio-frequency identification (RFID) technology, a dedicated customer-support team, and a secure database to track and trace cannabis from growth, harvest, and processing to testing, transport, and sale. As the Implementation Specialist, you will have the opportunity to thrive in a fast-moving, fluid environment, and be passionate about implementing change, great processes and procedures in a commercial setting at a fast-growing technology company.

**GENERAL OVERVIEW**

As an Implementation Specialist, you will play a pivotal role in the success of Metrc’s Retail ID product offering and optimization of our cloud-based platform to align with our company's needs and the evolving expectations of our clients. This position requires a unique blend of technical proficiency, keen analytical skills, and a collaborative spirit to effectively engage with various internal teams and external partners.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Core duties and responsibilities include the following:

* Guide clients through the onboarding process, including system setup, configuration, integration, and data migration as needed
* Work closely with clients to understand their unique requirements and implement our solution to meet their needs and ensure seamless integration with their existing platforms

jobs.title: EHR Specialist
jobs.description:
The Electronic Health Record (EHR) Specialist, will play a key role in optimizing EHR solutions that enable Aledade’s partner practices to improve patient outcomes, reduce healthcare costs, and increase efficiency.

The EHR Specialist will collaborate with practice stakeholders along with the multi-disciplinary Aledade team to identify, develop, and implement EHR solutions to support strategic ACO initiatives. Additionally, this role will facilitate the collection of practice-generated data that can be used for population-based analytics.

They will have depth of knowledge in at least one top-tier ambulatory EHR solution, have a strong understanding of practice workflow, and be able to travel periodically. The EHR Specialist must thrive in a fast-paced environment, respond well to change, and be a strong verbal and written communicator.

### **Primary Duties**

* Lead EHR Optimization efforts for assigned projects:

  + Coordinate efforts to conduct assessments of how practices are currently utilizing their EHR systems and identify areas where their systems can be optimized to support ACO initiatives.
  + Assist practices to fully leverage their existing EHR systems or other 3rd party systems to support strategic ACO initiatives.
  + Assist practices with implementing technology to provide point of care population health insights that work in conjunction with their EHR.
  + Support practices with MIPS compliance.

* Provide EHR expertise:

  + Identify common approaches, such as templates or customized reports that practices can use to achieve specific aims, such as Medicare Wellness Visits, Transitions of Care, Advance Care Planning, or Risk/Hierarchical Condition Categories.
  + Identify existing or develop new educational materials that can assist practice staff in understanding how best to utilize their EHR system.
  + Understand relevant EHR vendor system updates specifically related to population health management.
  + Develop and support EHR-system-specific user groups composed of representatives from Aledade’s ACO practices to identify best practices and training opportunities.
  + Provide strategic input on how EHR optimization can support ACO initiatives.

* Facilitate data exchange:

  + Assist practices in ensuring data is properly captured in their EHR systems in order to accurately generate quality measure and other reporting.
  + Ensure practices are able to share practice-generated data with Aledade.
  + Assist with development of integrations, interfaces, and data sharing strategies for assigned practices.

* Project Management:

  + Independently manage multiple projects at various stages to provide Aledade’s tools and train practice staff on patient-centric, value based workflows.
  + Communicate project progress effectively to internal and external stakeholders.
  + Present to audiences ranging from practice leadership/executives to front line staff, influencing adoption of best practices and materials that orient to Aledade’s service.
  + Proficiently deliver detailed but concise training content on complex material to multiple client stakeholders.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* A Bachelor’s degree is required. Significant and relevant work experience in lieu of educational requirements may be accepted.
* 4-6 years experience working as a client-facing project lead in the healthcare industry (i.e., ambulatory practice, EHR vendor, health plan, hospital, government, management consulting) with a proven track record of creating, maintaining, and enhancing customer relationships and optimization of their EHR systems.
* Must have previous implementation or optimization experience with top-tier ambulatory EHRs and practice management software, preferably with expertise in Epic Ambulatory, NextGen, Athena, Greenway, or eClinicalWorks products.

### **Preferred KSA’s**

* Relevant competencies include developing and maintaining relationships with all team members, organizational skills, project management, critical thinking, problem solving, attention to detail, and effective written and verbal communication.
* Must be self motivated and open to learn new EHR platforms/workflows.
* Must be results-oriented with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while maintaining focus on key goals.

### **Physical Requirements**

*Sitting* *for prolonged periods of time. Extensive use of computers and keyboard. Occasional walking and lifting may be required.*

**Who We Are:**

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.

**What Does This Mean for You?**

At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.

In addition to time off to support work-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:

Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners

Stock options

And much more!

**About First Due**

First Due’s mission is to prevent first responder injury or death by providing fire and EMS agencies with transformative, end-to-end software solutions that empower them to run safer, smarter, and more effective operations.

### **Job Title: Implementation Consultant, Fire Prevention**

**Location**: Remote - US Only  
**Country**: United States  
**Department**: Professional Services  
**Reports To**: Manager, Implementation Consulting  
**Position Type**: Full-Time  
**Salary**: $80,000

### **Job Summary:**

The Implementation Consultant, Fire Prevention US owns the configuration, deployment, and customer enablement of First Due's Fire Prevention suite across the US customer base, with primary delivery in the Core segment, on-call complex-configuration support to Essentials, and contribution to Enterprise engagements. Fire Prevention is one of First Due's most configuration-intensive modules. The role demands command of fire inspection and code enforcement practice, including inspections, permitting, invoicing, investigations, and the inspection, testing, and maintenance (ITM) of fire protection systems. This role is accountable for translating an agency's prevention and code enforcement program into a correct, maintainable First Due configuration and for a training and go-live experience that earns inspector and administrator adoption.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

#### **Module configuration and delivery**

* Configure inspection programs, including occupancy records, inspection types and routes, code-based checklists, and scheduling aligned to the agency's adopted fire code (NFPA 1, IFC, or local amendments).
* Configure permitting, including operational and burn permits, application and review workflows, and renewals.
* Configure invoicing and fee collection across permits, inspections, and other billable prevention activities.
* Configure inspection, testing, and maintenance (ITM) workflows for fire protection systems, including third-party contractor report submission, deficiency tracking, and compliance follow-up.
* Configure fire investigation workflows, including cause and origin documentation.
* Configure code enforcement, violations, and plan review, including violation tracking, notices, re-inspection cycles, and new-construction review routing.

#### **Project execution and product partnership**

* Partner with the assigned Implementation Manager to deliver Fire Prevention milestones on plan, surfacing risks early.
* Maintain accurate project status, level-of-effort actuals, and configuration documentation in Rocketlane.
* Serve as the Fire Prevention subject matter expert on assigned projects across segments.
* Surface product gaps, defects, and field-driven enhancement requests for Fire Prevention to the Team Manager and Product organization.

### **Qualifications:**

* Three or more years of customer-facing implementation, configuration, or professional services experience in a SaaS environment, or equivalent experience in fire prevention, code enforcement, or fire inspection.
* Strong public safety industry knowledge, with emphasis on fire prevention, fire code enforcement, and inspection practice.
* Working knowledge of fire prevention workflows, including inspections, permitting, invoicing, investigations, and ITM (inspection, testing, and maintenance), within adopted code frameworks (NFPA 1, IFC, or local amendments).
* Familiarity with plan review and fire investigation processes.
* Experience translating program or regulatory requirements into software configuration.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent customer projects.
* Excellent communication, training delivery, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Experience with Rocketlane or a comparable professional services delivery platform.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft products, including Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, Word, and Excel).

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Direct experience as a fire inspector, fire marshal or deputy fire marshal, plans examiner, fire investigator, or company officer with inspection duties.
* Fire prevention certifications such as ICC Fire Inspector I or II, NFPA Certified Fire Inspector, Fire Plans Examiner, or Fire Investigator (NFPA 1033).
* Hands-on experience with fire prevention or inspection platforms, and with inspection, testing, and maintenance (ITM) or third-party compliance reporting workflows.
* Familiarity with GIS and parcel data as applied to occupancy and inspection management.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce, including account data hygiene and project handoff from sales.
* PMP, ITIL, or equivalent professional certification.
* Direct hands-on experience with Rocketlane.

**For US-based Roles**

Hiring is contingent upon candidates successfully passing a criminal background check. **Working at First Due**  
First Due offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package for eligible employees, including competitive pay, medical, dental, and vision coverage, FSA/HSA, 401(k), flexible PTO, a fully remote workplace, a technology stipend, opportunities for advancement, and other benefits and perks that sets our team apart. You will serve as a hands-on systems and product analyst across Epic, Oracle Health, and related EHR/EMR platforms. As a valued member of the Healthcare Consulting team, you will collaborate with clients, product leaders, architects, clinical stakeholders, interface teams, and delivery professionals to translate complex requirements into reliable system solutions.

* Work as a hands-on systems and product analyst across Epic, Oracle Health, or comparable EHR/EMR platforms, supporting billable client engagements throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Lead requirements discovery sessions and translate clinical, operational, and technical needs into epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, functional requirements, workflow designs, and build specifications.

###

Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. They may change based on the project you are engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations.

### **What you must have to be considered**

* At least 8 years of experience in healthcare information technology, consulting, professional services, or technology-enabled healthcare transformation, including at least three years in hands-on EHR/EMR analyst roles.
